biomarkers.name: Complex karyotype (no MDM2 amplification)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports distinction from WD/DD-LPS, which characteristically shows MDM2 amplification; pleomorphic liposarcoma lacks a recurrent pathognomonic amplification or fusion.

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.clinical_use: Associated with complex genomic instability; not an established routine standalone prognostic biomarker specific to pleomorphic liposarcoma.

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Pleomorphic, high-grade sarcoma with pleomorphic lipoblasts (defining feature) in the absence of MDM2 amplification

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Pleomorphic spindle and multinucleated cells with lipoblastic differentiation

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Uncertain — mesenchymal cells with variable adipocytic differentiation potential; distinct from WD/DD LPS (no MDM2 amplification) and myxoid LPS (no DDIT3 fusion)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Pleomorphic, high-grade sarcoma with pleomorphic lipoblasts (defining feature); complex karyotype is typical and TP53 alterations are recurrent
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Represents primary high-grade adipocytic sarcoma without the distinctive molecular signatures of other liposarcomas; complex genomic instability drives pleomorphic phenotype
